topic: Exterior Light Control System - Main Beam Light Switch Status Feedback
row_semantics: Each row represents a specific signal or state related to the main beam light switch control process, including its current status and fault conditions.
column_semantics: The table has two main columns: one for the signal/module description and another for the corresponding value or status definition.

core_timing_constraints.description: Synchronization requirement for main beam lights
core_timing_constraints.condition: Left and right main beam lights must be synchronized
core_timing_constraints.timing: Maximum delay between left and right sides cannot exceed 40ms

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the signal states and fault conditions for the main beam light switch control module (LHZCU) within the exterior light control system. It is used to verify that the LHZCU correctly reports the main beam light switch status and fault conditions to the ICB (Integrated Control Box) and ensures proper synchronization between the left and right main beam lights.
